profile_text.body:
Quora is a knowledge-sharing platform founded in 2009 and headquartered in Mountain View. The company describes itself as "a place to share knowledge and better understand the world," operating a question-and-answer site where users post, answer, and browse questions across a wide range of topics.

On the AI side, Quora offers Poe, a multi-model aggregator that gives users access to a variety of large language models through a single interface. Poe is tracked in the Chat and General LLMs category and is available at poe.com.

The held facts note no litigation or regulatory filings associated with Quora at this time.
